w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Zoltan just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "You snore in movements. Allegro, adagio, a finale that rattles the set. The judges have never seen anything like it. Neither has anyone."
firstContext: Your stomach is a fist. Eat — anything real, now.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
📺 SYSTEM: "You snore in movements. Allegro, adagio, a finale that rattles the set. The judges have never seen anything like it. Neither has anyone."
📺 SYSTEM: "📈 your showbiz fans +3 — the snore symphony (favor: 7)"
📺 SYSTEM: "🎨 COLOR: It did the thing! Should we be proud? I feel something. Is this pride? Log it."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (20/11/8), with 6 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 7 · Craft 4 · Talk 15 · Explore 26 → 24 · capped)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Hauwa Adesina ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
